**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What the document has:** §5 gives only a knowledge-qualified legal-compliance warranty (p0024), a rights/authority warranty (p0025), a non-infringement warranty (p0026) and anti-bribery covenants (p0027–p0029), followed by a disclaimer of implied warranties (p0030). §1(b) has a bare "professional and workmanlike" performance covenant (p0005).
- **Gap:** no warranty that the Services or Works conform to the Specifications/documentation, no warranty period, and no repair/re-perform/refund remedy — while merchantability and fitness are disclaimed. That fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new §5(f) adding a professional-and-workmanlike warranty plus a 90-day conformance warranty for each deliverable/Work, with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund as our remedy, and confirming the express warranties are not swallowed by the §5(e) disclaimer.
